protocolRefs.multiCallChain: Mail message building: MAIL New attachment creates attachment objects to add into an Email object's attachments collection -> MAIL Convert to MIME serializes the completed email object to MIME text (used internally by SMTP_transporter.send()) -> MAIL Convert from MIME parses an inbound MIME document back into an email object.

constraints: If name is omitted: when the source is a file/path, the file's own name and extension are used; when the source is a BLOB or ZipFile, a random name without extension is generated.

If type is omitted or an empty string, the content-type is inferred from the attachment's file extension (per the documented extension-to-MIME-type table); an explicit type overrides this regardless of extension.
If disposition is omitted: it defaults to "inline" when a non-empty cid is passed, otherwise it defaults to "attachment".
cid may be passed as an empty string to explicitly opt out of the Content-Id header.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a mail attachment object from a 4D.File (file reference).

discriminatedBy.rule: Selected when the attachment source is passed as a 4D.File object.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a mail attachment object from a 4D.ZipFile (zip archive entry/file reference).

discriminatedBy.rule: Selected when the attachment source is passed as a 4D.ZipFile object.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a mail attachment object directly from in-memory binary content held in a 4D.Blob.

discriminatedBy.rule: Selected when the attachment source is passed as a 4D.Blob object.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a mail attachment object from a document identified by a system-syntax pathname or file name (searched next to the project file if only a file name is given).

discriminatedBy.rule: Selected when the attachment source is passed as a Text pathname/file name.
